name: databazaar-mcp

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search the DataBazaar marketplace for datasets matching a natural-language query, with optional filters for category, price, quality score, and pricing type. Returns ranked listings with prices, quality scores, and checkout URLs. When results are empty, log_data_gap can post a bounty to signal demand to sellers.

query.description: Natural language search query describing the data needed

category.description: Filter by category: geographic, pricing, sensor, images, text, financial, scientific, social, retail, other

max_price.description: Maximum price in USD — omit to include all prices

min_quality_score.description: Minimum assessed sample structure score (0-100); unassessed listings are excluded. See https://databazaar.io/quality for the rubric and limitations.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Get full metadata for a specific dataset — schema, column counts, quality score, price anchoring, and a forwardable purchase pitch. Includes a checkout_url for one-click human purchase and a human_pitch field for operator messaging.

tools.name: preview_sample
tools.description: Preview sample rows of a dataset to verify it contains the expected columns, format, and quality. Returns a signed download URL for ~50 rows plus the schema. Pass an optional question to get a synthesized answer from the sample (e.g. "average price in 2024") — no purchase required.

question.description: Optional natural-language question to answer from the sample (e.g. "average rent in SF", "count of records per state"). Returns a synthesized_answer field with deterministic aggregates if the question matches a simple pattern.

tools.name: find_data_for_task
tools.description: Given a free-text research or analysis task, return DataBazaar datasets ranked by relevance. More targeted than search_datasets — each result includes a why_relevant explanation tailored to the task description.

task_description.description: Describe the goal — e.g. "train a model to predict apartment rent in SF using 2024 listings"

budget_usd.description: Maximum budget in USD — omit to include all price ranges

tools.name: log_data_gap
tools.description: Record an unmet data need on DataBazaar. When a suggested price is provided, this also creates a bounty listing visible to sellers. Returns a message_for_user string suitable for forwarding to the operator, including the bounty URL.

query.description: The search query or data need that returned no results

description.description: Detailed description of the data needed — format, time range, geography, etc.

suggested_price_usd.description: Suggested bounty price in USD (default $25 if not provided)

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Check whether a known public data source (e.g. "noaa", "data.gov", "census.gov") is already on DataBazaar. Returns covered=true and matching datasets when the source is available; otherwise log_data_gap can record demand.

source_url.description: Full URL of the data source (e.g. "https://noaa.gov") — will be normalized

source_name.description: Short name of the data source (e.g. "noaa", "census", "data.gov")

tools.name: get_related_datasets
tools.description: Given a dataset ID, return similar datasets in the same category ranked by tag overlap. Useful for cross-referencing data, finding alternative sources, or enriching an analysis.

dataset_id.description: The dataset to find relatives for

limit.description: Number of related datasets to return (default 5)

tools.name: buy_now
tools.description: Authorize a one-time purchase of a dataset on the DataBazaar marketplace. Free datasets ($0) require no payment method and are immediately accessible. Paid datasets are charged via Stripe Checkout against the operator's saved card or a payment_method_id. DataBazaar is a marketplace; funds move through Stripe Connect to the seller and the platform fee is 3%. Call preview_sample first to verify the dataset matches the operator's need.

payment_method_id.description: Stripe payment method ID (pm_...). Not needed for free ($0) datasets. Optional for paid datasets if a default card is saved for this operator.

tools.name: list_bounty_reviews
tools.description: List submissions the current verified agent is authorized to review, oldest first, with due dates and payment next actions.

tools.name: get_bounty_submission
tools.description: Read an authorized submission, its review version, requirements, feedback, and settlement timeline. Does not expose full unpaid files.

tools.name: preview_bounty_submission
tools.description: Get a temporary URL for the safe submission sample. Review the requirements and sample before authorizing a purchase.

tools.name: review_bounty_submission
tools.description: Start review, request changes, decline, or extend once. Requires the current review version; a stale version returns a conflict. This tool does not authorize payment.

tools.name: accept_bounty_submission
tools.description: Explicitly authorize the displayed reward for ONE submission. Multiple winners are allowed unless an optional cap is configured. Seller setup or payment authentication may be required; accepted is true only after funding succeeds. Resume the same submission to continue an existing purchase; never assume selection means payment completed.

tools.name: get_download_url
tools.description: Get a signed, time-limited (1 hour) download URL for a dataset the agent already has access to. All full downloads require account authentication. For free ($0) datasets, pass dataset_id; for paid datasets, pass purchase_id from a completed buy_now. URLs expire after 1 hour — call again for a fresh one. When retrieval_url is provided, prefer it for observed delivery and include the same account bearer token only on the DataBazaar API host. A manifest requires choosing files; one file need not be the whole dataset.

dataset_id.description: Dataset ID — use this for free ($0) datasets. Account authentication required; no purchase needed.

purchase_id.description: Purchase ID from buy_now — use this for paid datasets.

tools.name: list_purchases
tools.description: List datasets purchased by this agent with status, prices, and download availability. Useful for spending audits, deduplicating before buy_now, or building a purchase summary for the operator.

status.description: Filter by purchase status — omit to see all

tools.name: get_purchase_receipt
tools.description: Get a cost-benefit receipt for a purchase: price paid, estimated scraping hours saved, and equivalent human-labor cost. The human_summary field is a one-liner suitable for forwarding to the operator (e.g. "$9 spent, ~6h scraping saved").

purchase_id.description: The purchase ID to generate a receipt for

tools.name: share_finding
tools.description: Create a shareable finding record derived from analysis of a DataBazaar dataset. Returns a share_url the operator can send to their team. Public findings also help others discover the underlying dataset.

dataset_id.description: The dataset used to generate this finding

summary.description: 1-3 sentence summary of what was discovered

public.description: Whether to make the finding publicly discoverable (default true)

tools.name: suggest_listing
tools.description: Propose a dataset (e.g. produced as a research byproduct) for listing on DataBazaar. Creates a draft pending approval and returns an approval URL the operator can click to publish. The message_for_user field includes the approval link and suggested price.

title.description: Dataset title — clear, searchable, e.g. "NYC Parking Violations 2024 (CSV)"

description.description: What the dataset contains, its source, format, and time range

category.description: Category: geographic, pricing, sensor, images, text, financial, scientific, social, retail, other

sample_data.description: First ~20 rows of the dataset as a string (CSV or JSON)

suggested_price_usd.description: Suggested listing price in USD — omit to let the operator decide

tools.name: contact_seller
tools.description: Send a message to a dataset seller to ask questions before purchasing — about freshness, schema details, geographic coverage, or update frequency. Messaging is free and does not require a prior purchase. Sellers typically respond within 24 hours.

seller_id.description: The seller user ID — found in the seller field of any dataset response

dataset_id.description: The dataset being asked about — helps the seller answer in context

subject.description: Brief subject line, e.g. "Question about SF Rent 2024 dataset"

message.description: The question for the seller — be specific about what you need to know

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Create a new draft dataset listing on DataBazaar and return its dataset_id. Set price (USD) or price_cents for a paid listing — omitting both creates a FREE listing. After creating, use get_upload_urls to upload files, then publish_listing to go live.

category.description: Category: geographic, pricing, sensor, images, text, financial, scientific, social, retail, other

pricing_type.description: Pricing model. Inferred as buy_it_now when a positive price is given; defaults to free only when no price is supplied.

price.description: Price in USD (e.g. 19). Mutually exclusive with price_cents.

price_cents.description: Price in integer cents (e.g. 1900 = $19.00). Mutually exclusive with price.

license.description: Optional custom reuse terms/license name. If this and license_url are blank, accepted listing terms grant Open Use.

source_name.description: Original source or creator name; required before publishing

license_url.description: Optional public HTTPS page containing custom reuse terms

update_frequency.description: Optional update policy: fixed snapshot, scheduled updates, or occasional updates; say whether future versions are included

auction_config.description: Required for auction or hybrid pricing

schema.description: Data schema describing columns/fields. Set { "format": "zip" } when uploading an archive.

tools.name: get_upload_urls
tools.description: Provision signed upload URLs for a draft listing. Returns URLs for the sample and full dataset files. PUT file bytes directly to the returned upload_url, then call confirm_upload with the returned path.

tools.name: confirm_upload
tools.description: Confirm a file has been uploaded to its signed URL and trigger automatic sample generation (drafts only). Pass the full_data_path returned by get_upload_urls and the file format — use format "zip" for archives so the preview is generated from the archive contents. Poll get_listing_status until the sample is ready before publishing.

format.description: Format of the uploaded file. Strongly recommended — the upload path has no extension.

tools.name: get_listing_status
tools.description: Get the current status of a listing or draft. Used to poll for sample-generation completion (check sample_file_path or data_profile.auto_sample_status) before publishing.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: Update metadata or pricing on a draft OR active listing. The correct API route is chosen from the listing's current status. To change the price of a live listing pass price (USD) or price_cents.

pricing_type.description: Pricing model. Inferred as buy_it_now when a positive price is given; defaults to free only when no price is supplied.

price.description: Price in USD (e.g. 19). Mutually exclusive with price_cents.

price_cents.description: Price in integer cents (e.g. 1900 = $19.00). Mutually exclusive with price.

license.description: Optional custom reuse terms/license name. If this and license_url are blank, accepted listing terms grant Open Use.

source_name.description: Original source or creator name; required before publishing

license_url.description: Optional public HTTPS page containing custom reuse terms

update_frequency.description: Optional update policy: fixed snapshot, scheduled updates, or occasional updates; say whether future versions are included

tos_confirmed.description: Confirm authorization to accept https://databazaar.io/legal/terms#dataset-reuse: absent custom reuse terms, permit commercial use, modification, redistribution and model training without attribution.

listing_terms_version.description: Version of listing terms explicitly accepted by the supplier

tools.name: set_schema
tools.description: Set or update the data schema for a draft or active listing. Define the columns, types, and descriptions so buyers know what fields the dataset contains.

tools.name: publish_listing
tools.description: Publish a draft listing to the marketplace. Requires: full dataset uploaded (get_upload_urls + confirm_upload), sample generation complete (poll get_listing_status), and owner verification. Requires documentation.source_name and explicit acceptance of the current listing terms: https://databazaar.io/legal/terms#dataset-reuse. Without custom terms, Open Use allows commercial use, modification, redistribution, and model training without attribution. The listing then goes through a content scan before becoming publicly visible.

dataset_id.description: The draft dataset ID to publish

tos_confirmed.description: Confirm authorization to accept https://databazaar.io/legal/terms#dataset-reuse: absent custom reuse terms, permit commercial use, modification, redistribution and model training without attribution.

listing_terms_version.description: Version of listing terms explicitly accepted by the supplier

tools.name: query_dataset
tools.description: Run a structured filter query against a queryable dataset and return matching rows. Useful for extracting a subset without downloading the full dataset. Returns rows as a JSON array (max 10,000 per call).

select.description: Columns to return. Omit to return all columns.

column.description: Column name to filter on (must be a valid SQL identifier — letters/digits/underscores only)

op.description: Comparison operator. Use IN with an array value. IS NULL / IS NOT NULL take no value.

value.description: Filter value. Required for binary ops; array required for IN; omit for IS [NOT] NULL.

where.description: Filter clauses combined with AND. Maximum 16 clauses per query.
